ruling.recommended_action: Issue a Ryde voucher of $2.20 (refund of metered distance overcharge for the 1.56 km unexempt detour around the jammed AYE) within 30 days per NS-7; keep the rest of the metered fare and the waiting-time units unchanged.

segment_findings.reason: Off-route segment ~22:53:55–23:05:25 (≈1.56 km) where the GPS trace leaves the quoted AYE/Central Expressway alignment and runs via 1.281/103.814–1.284/103.800 before rejoining. Driver cites the jammed AYE, and band-1 speed records exist on the optimal route (SYN-1002, SYN-0007), but there is no traffic-incident record (RD-4(a)) and RD-4(b) bands alone are only corroborative (G3); the jam justify→ detour link is not evidenced for the substituted stretch. No prior rider agreement in chat before the divergence (RD-5). Unexempt under RD-1/RD-4(c), refundable per RD-2.

rejected_claims.reason: The quoted route was 10.761 km and the meter read 12.41 km; only the 1.56 km unexempt detour is refundable (RD-2), not the whole distance gap or the ~0.09 km map-matching residual.
Speed bands alone do not exempt a segment under RD-4(b) absent a traffic incident on the replaced stretch; the reason given covers the expressway but not the corridor actually driven (RD-4(c)).
